analysis.description: Opening subject and answer entries only, manually transcribed from the score and checked against Saayman's discussion. The rest of the fugue is not represented.

notes: The excerpt includes the opening eighth-note pickup as m. 0, then mm. 1–19. This is the set's descending soprano–alto–tenor–bass exposition. The initial octave leap and six repeated eighth notes are shown in the preview. Manual reading of the public-domain score, corroborated by Saayman's discussion of entry order and subject design. Quarter-note coordinates are relative to each fugue, not to its prelude. Only the opening exposition is mapped. Entry endpoints mark the subject core; continuing counterpoint and extensions are not automatically included.
